'''H'nemthe'''<ref name="CL" /> were a [[Reptile|reptilian]]<ref name="Victory's Price">''[[Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel]]''</ref> [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]<ref name="ANH" /> with sharp [[tongue]]s. [[M'iiyoom Onith]] was a member of this species, and she was courted by the [[Gotal]] tax collector [[Feltipern Trevagg]], who did not know the dangers of romancing a H'nemthe.<ref name="CL" />

==H'nemthe in the galaxy==
A H'menthe named M’iiyoom Onith appeared in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]<ref name="CL" /> in [[1 BBY]],<ref name="IV 
Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> sharing a booth with Gotal tax collector [[Feltipern Trevagg]] and Givin smuggler [[Elis Helrot]]. Unaware of H'menthe mating customs, Trevagg attempted to romance Onith, not realizing the potential consequences.<ref name="CL" />

In [[0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars (2015) 10|''Star Wars'' (2015) 10]]'' to [[0 ABY]].</ref> while searching for [[Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi|Grakkus the Hutt]] on [[Nar Shaddaa]], [[C-3PO]] and [[Chewbacca]] entered an [[Unidentified bar (Nar Shaddaa)|bar]]. Among the patrons was a H'menthe.<ref name="SW1510">''[[Star Wars (2015) 10|''Star Wars'' (2015) 10]]''</ref>

At [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba’s Palace]] during the [[Rescue of Han Solo]] in [[4 ABY]], a H'menthe was visible while [[Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker]] were escorted to the [[Khetanna]]<ref name="ROTJ">''{{Film|VI}}''</ref>

In 5 ABY During an incident at the [[Circus of Mortal Appetites]], [[Nath Tensent]] encountered an H'menthe. After pulling aside a curtain, he came face to face with the protruding nose of the reptilian humanoid. The H'menthe let out a sound between a hiss and a yelp before slipping agilely past Nath and [[Chass na Chadic]], disappearing into the crowded shellmongers’ tent.<ref name="Victory's Price" />

==Behind the scenes==
The H'nemthe species first appeared in {{Film|IV}} in [[1977]].
